attributes.action: Reduce food packaging on certain goods.
attributes.background: Particular food items (crisps, nuts, grated cheese, confectionary goods etc.) are packaged excessively. It creates false advertising, unnecessary waste and higher production costs passed onto consumers. All food items should be packaged within parameters not overly exceeding the necessary limits.

rejection.details: Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action. We are not sure what specific regulations you would like the Government to introduce.
